data.title: Atletico Madrid vs Viking – Predicted lineup and team news - Yahoo Sports
data.content:
Even with those absences, Simeone has plenty of attacking options available. He is expected to use a conventional 4-4-2 setup. Lee Kang-in is making a strong case to start up front alongside Julián Álvarez.

Álex Baena is likely to keep his position on the left wing, while Johnny Cardoso is expected to play a key role in central midfield, helping Atlético control the pace of the game against the Norwegian side.

## Atletico Madrid predicted lineup [...] Atlético Madrid face the league-phase fixture at the Riyadh Air Metropolitano Stadium with several injury concerns.

Simeone will be unable to call on forward Ademola Lookman, who is still dealing with a knee problem. Defender Cristian Romero is also out with a muscular injury, while right-back Marc Pubill remains sidelined as he recovers from an ankle issue. [...] Atlético Madrid come into the game in good form overall, having won seven of their past ten matches in all competitions. Diego Simeone's team recovered from back-to-back losses to Bayern Munich and Barcelona with an emphatic 3-0 victory over Getafe in La Liga on November 22. Still, their Champions League results have been uneven. They sit 23rd with one win, one draw, and two defeats, meaning they cannot afford another poor result at home.

## Team News

Atletico will be without the services of Ademola Lookman (knee), Marc Pubill (ankle) and Cristian Romero (muscular) for the Champions League fixture with Viking.

Lee Kang-in could be introduced into the starting side on Wednesday, with the 25-year-old potentially featuring alongside Julian Alvarez in the final third of the field. [...] Alex Baena is set to continue down the left off the back of his excellent performance against Getafe, while Johnny Cardoso is likely to feature in the middle of the midfield.

As for Viking, Anders Baertelsen (foot), Sondre Bjorshol (knee), Nick D'Agostino (leg) and Martin Ove Roseth (muscular) are out of the match due to injury problems. [...] Meanwhile, Veton Berisha (unspecified) and Kristoffer Haugen (unspecified) both need to be assessed before final decisions on their availability can be made.

Peter Christiansen is the team's leading goalscorer this season with 19, and the 26-year-old will once again feature in the final third of the field.

It stands to reason that he could play against Elche at the weekend, though this feels unlikely with a rematch against FC Barcelona looming in eight days’ time.
